title: Heeling apparatus and method
abstract: A heeling apparatus includes a shoe with a unique feature in the heel that allows one to walk, run, or roll seamlessly. The appearance is that of normal footwear because of the covert wheel assembly. The stealth wheel in the heel gives one the ability to roll or slide in areas you could only walk.
gist: Footwear with a concealed wheel in the heel (Heelys). Users lift their forefoot to roll on the heel wheel or lower it to walk normally, turning ordinary-looking shoes into rolling gear without separate equipment.
